title: The Blanket Question
description:
KakaoTalk from Jae-won.

'Hey. One month in. You asked about my blanket on move-in day — I actually bought a thick one. Slept warm all month.'

Some messages land like that.

choices.result_text:
'Thank you haha' came back immediately.

That first week — alone in a tiny room, not knowing anyone. There's a version of this city where someone asks about your blanket.
{name} is that person now.

choices.text: Open the door — look down the hallway
choices.result_text:
Two years ago, {name} stood in that same spot. Box in hand, dazed.

Something has shifted. Not finished. But different from where it started.

title: Still Going for the ₩3B?
description:
KakaoTalk from Jae-won.

'Hey are you still doing the ₩3 billion thing lol. Randomly thought of it.'

The night {name} had said it out loud. In this room. Jae-won's eyes had gone wide.

choices.result_text:
'lol respect. I'll work hard too'

Someone is watching to see if you follow through.
That's extra weight — or extra fuel. Today it was fuel.

'But you're still doing it right? That's the hard part'

{name} held the screen for a moment.
Jae-won hasn't been here long enough to know how tiring 'still doing it' can get. But he's not wrong.

description:
Room 203 has been dark for a week.

Jae-won left. Every time the hall is walked, that door catches the eye.
New tenant hasn't moved in yet.

{name} stopped in front of it.

choices.text: Hope he makes it — wherever he went
choices.result_text:
Hyun-su left. Now Jae-won.
{name} is still here.

This goshiwon is a corridor. Everyone passes through.
When the next person arrives — ask about the blanket.

choices.text: Wonder: when does this hallway end for me too?
choices.result_text:
Ran the numbers. When's the exit?
They didn't come out clean.

Jae-won left because something opened up. {name} has to make that opening.
The room is still here. The time is still ticking.

title: The Card in the Wallet
description:
Cleaning out the wallet — a business card.

Lee Min-seo. The woman who owns the Gangnam apartment.

'If you want to know how I did it, reach out.'

Months since she said that.

choices.text: Send the message — ask to meet
choices.result_text:
'I've been waiting. Let's get coffee.'

Fast reply.

A card that sat in a wallet for three months finally got used.

choices.text: Not yet — not ready to stand in front of her
choices.result_text:
Wants to show up with something to show.
Not empty-handed.

Put the card back. Still there when it's time.

title: When the Goal Disappears
description:
Something Min-seo said keeps coming back.

'When you have a goal — prepare for when it disappears.'

Made no sense then. Getting closer now.

choices.text: Think about what comes after ₩3 billion
choices.result_text:
'If I hit the number — then what?'

Uncomfortable question. The goal had been the engine.
Without it: who am I?

Min-seo must have been talking about this. Now it makes sense.

choices.text: Not there yet — focus on the goal first
choices.result_text:
That's a problem for a later version of {name}.
Get there first.

But her expression when she said it — 'that's the hardest part' — doesn't fully leave.
